Tim is Icelandic, Thor is his Icelandic name, apparently Icelandic people have an Icelandic name in addition to their Canadian birth name. Whats most likely going to happen is something like this: "Hey Tim! err.. I mean Thor." Knowing his short fuse he wont like this. Am i the asshole here?
